_comment: Gzipped production-bundle size budgets in KB. `npm run budget` (and CI) fails if any is exceeded. These guard first-load weight for indigent patients on slow connections. When a change legitimately grows a bundle, bump the relevant number here in the same PR and say why — that keeps growth a deliberate, reviewed decision instead of silent drift. Headroom over the 2026-09-29 baseline is ~10-15%.
